import ctypes, json, random, sys, collections
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from gen import gen_batch
from fuzz4 import enrich
from netnomos.finite import compile_batch

stats=collections.Counter()
for i in range(600):
    rng=random.Random(700000+i)
    big = rng.random()<0.4
    batch=gen_batch(rng, jobs=rng.randint(1,3), big=big, width=rng.randint(1,4),
                    max_pred=rng.randint(1,9), max_universe=1200 if big else 300)
    enrich(batch,rng)
    got=compile_batch(batch)
    for res in got['results']:
        stats['jobs']+=1
        stats['rules']+=len(res['rules'])
        stats['active']+=len(res['active'])
        if res['rules']: stats['jobs_with_rules']+=1
        if res['active']: stats['jobs_with_active']+=1
        for a in res['answers']:
            stats['answers']+=1
            if a['count']: stats['answers_nonzero']+=1
            if a['witness'] is not None: stats['answers_witness']+=1
            if 'END' in a['tokens']: stats['answers_end']+=1
            stats['tokens']+=len(a['tokens'])
            if not a['tokens']: stats['answers_empty_tokens']+=1
        for r in res['rules']:
            stats['rule_len_%d'%len(r['clause'])]+=1
print(json.dumps(stats, indent=1, sort_keys=True))
PYEOF
